rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something that causes death, especially a wound or injury.

example.english: A bite from this snake can be mortal.
example.traditional: 呢種蛇嘅咬傷可以致命。
example.jyutping: ni1 zung2 se4 ge3 ngaau5 soeng1 ho2 ji5 zi3 ming6

rows.note: Use this when saying that a person or living thing is capable of dying rather than immortal.

example.english: People are mortal and cannot assume they will live forever.
example.traditional: 人始終係會死嘅，唔可以當自己長生不老。
example.jyutping: jan4 ci2 zung1 hai6 wui5 sei2 ge3 m4 ho2 ji5 dong1 zi6 gei2 coeng4 sang1 bat1 lou5

rows.note: Use this specifically for a mortal enemy or an enemy involved in a life-and-death struggle.

example.english: They are mortal enemies and fight whenever they meet.
example.traditional: 佢哋兩個係死敵，見面就鬥。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 hai6 sei2 dik6 gin3 min6 zau6 dau3
